data.description: LevelDB JNI 为 Google 开发的快速键值存储库 LevelDB C++ 提供了 Java 接口，可提供从字符串键到字符串值的有序映射。
data.label: LevelDB JNI

data.description: LevelDB JNI gives you a Java interface to the LevelDB C++ library which is a fast key-value storage library written at Google that provides an ordered mapping from string keys to string values.
